name: Coastal Habitat Aquarium V01
description: Coastal Habitat Aquarium, increment 1 of 7 (about 250 objects). An organic, modelled habitat tank: curved outline and leaning walls, sculpted rockwork, a three-level floor with a cavern under the shelf, bridges over and tunnels through, kelp forest and reef. Tap an animal to read about it. Sizes are estimates, in inches.

objects.description: the exhibit: a curved, lobed tank 110 ft long and about 65 ft across at most, 28 ft of water. Two storeys tall
